params.name: Orlov Continental 2076
params.note: The Continental after the Bulwark HX (docs/proposals/hover-rigs.md). Written by scripts/shapes/concepts/continental-2076.mjs from mesh_truck_continental.json; edit that, not this. Same channels as the stock file: trailer (+t), parked (~p), fit_<code> (^code).

body.note: the cab: the booth colour (gunmetal at the factory)

carbon.note: rocker, grille recess, screen frame, light bar, mirror heads

hazard.note: visor, chevrons, skirt band, kick plate: the booth trim colour (hazard orange at the factory)

rubber.note: mud flaps and the bumper rail

steel.note: bumper, slats, lamp pods, skirt, steps, vent, heat shields
